title: Kalup blueprints lock, version 1
description: blueprints.lock.json in the folder of object files (hubspot/ by default), written by `kalup add` and `kalup blueprint upgrade`, never by hand. Records where each blueprint came from, the stored original upgrades merge against, and which config resources it provides. Closed at every level.

sources.description: Every `<source>@<version>` ever recorded, to its hash: the same source and version with another hash is refused.

hash.description: sha256: and the hex digest of the bytes as fetched.

source.description: A path relative to the project root with forward slashes, or an https URL.

resources.description: Each local address the blueprint provides, to its address in the blueprint.

held.description: The conflicts the last upgrade kept config's value for.

local.description: Config's value; absent when config has none.

remote.description: The upstream value; absent when the blueprint has none.
